mission: Denouement — Ben tells Luke the truth. The Order will know. Ben's arc resolves. Final image.
conflict: Ben vs. the final choice — what to tell, who to be
notes:
Time: Days after climax
Thematic beat: Choosing a different path isn't betrayal. It's how you honor those who came before — by doing what they couldn't.
Original scene_outcome: Ben tells Luke everything. Luke agrees — the Order will learn the truth. Ben steps out of his father's shadow. Final image: Ben feeling his own frequency in the new seal. A note in a chord. Enough.
